research_question: Can typed absence, explicit provenance, and recoverable compaction prevent silent state loss in real long-running autonomous agents?

rq1.name: Ontology Formalization
rq1.question: Can absence be formalized as a useful computational ontology?

states_formalized.evidence: 8 states formalized (not_generated, not_invoked, unknown, unresolved, withheld, invalid, deleted, pruned_recoverable). Complete 64-entry transition table: 45 legal, 19 illegal.

hypothesis_verified.evidence: Hypothesis RuleBasedStateMachine: 10K examples x 30 steps = ~300K transitions, 0 invariant violations. All 19 illegal transitions parametrized and rejected.

mutation_score_above_85.evidence: 99.0% adjusted mutation score (103 killed / 104 non-equivalent out of 110 total mutants). 6 equivalent + 1 low-value survivors classified.

open_questions_resolved.evidence: CC-001: resolved is REF state, not_generated is 8th absence state. CC-002: timed_out/interrupted use metadata enrichment. CC-003: recoverability stays binary for Phase 1.

rq2.name: Violation Detection Reliability
rq2.question: Do typed absence and provenance-preserving protocols detect structural failures missed by ordinary logging?

natural_violation_detected.evidence: 0 natural violations on 30 clean runs. Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound: 11.6% (0.116). This blocks PASS.

differential_ci_excludes_zero.evidence: Differential detection: +0.444, bootstrap 95% CI [0.344, 0.544] excludes zero.

three_tier_ordering.evidence: forge >= structured >= uninstrumented holds for all 9 fault types (D1-D9).

limitations: Zero natural violations on 30 clean runs (CP upper bound 11.6%). Practical value on naturally-occurring failures undemonstrated.
5/9 fault types undetectable by post-hoc validation: D3 (hash), D4 (ref correctness), D6 (transition legality), D7 (trace data loss), D8 (content corruption).
Task corpus limited to coding/patching workflows (Zarathustra/OpenClaw).
44.4% aggregate detection rate is ENTIRELY on injected (synthetic) faults.

rq3.name: Compaction Survival
rq3.question: Can history be compacted while preserving grounded return paths?

genuine_compaction_measured.evidence: Only simulated LLM compaction (programmatic oldest-first deletion) tested. Genuine LLM context-window compaction not measured. This blocks PASS.

simulated_compaction_measured.evidence: 9 deletion fractions (0.1 to 0.9), 3 chambers from Phase 2 OpenClaw ledger.

reachability_characterized.evidence: Structural reachability degrades monotonically: 0.932 (10% deletion) to 0.250 (90% deletion).

above_backtracking_threshold.evidence: At 70% simulated deletion: structural reachability = 0.550 > 0.5 backtracking threshold. Threshold crossed at 80% (0.438).

violation_detection_maintained.evidence: D1/D2/D5/D9 all detected at 100% on all 3 chambers post-simulated-compaction.

limitations: Only simulated LLM compaction tested (programmatic deletion, not genuine LLM context-window compaction).
fp-short-tasks unresolved: no 128K+ token sessions tested.
3 chambers from same OpenClaw ledger. Narrow CIs reflect measurement precision, not trace diversity.
Degraded ref category empty (simulated deletion is binary, not semantic).
Simulated results are analytical lower bounds, not empirical measurements of genuine compaction.

fp-synthetic-only.notes: Natural violations assessed independently via separate clean campaign (30 runs). Zero natural violations honestly reported as negative finding with CP bound. Injected and natural strictly separated via separate_injected_natural(). Report does NOT conflate them.

fp-short-tasks.notes: Simulated LLM compaction on deep traces (depth=21, 40 stages) partially addresses this. However, no genuine 128K+ token sessions tested and no genuine LLM compaction events measured. Phase 4 honestly reported as 'partially addressed'.

fp-shallow-traces.notes: Phase 2 traces have depth=21 and 40 stages. Simulated LLM compaction at 70% removes 28 stages -- structurally meaningful deletion.

complexity_without_gains.evidence_for: 4/9 fault types detected at 100%. Differential detection +0.444, CI [0.344, 0.544] excludes zero. FPR = 0.0%. Three-tier ordering holds for all 9 types. Ontology verified by 10K+ adversarial sequences.
complexity_without_gains.evidence_against: Zero natural violations on 30 clean runs (CP UB 11.6%). 5/9 fault types undetectable by post-hoc validation.

provenance_fails_under_load.evidence_for: Pre-simulated-compaction reachability = 1.0 (matches MockLM ceiling). Structural reachability above threshold through 70% simulated deletion. Forge trace compression 1.196x. Violation detection maintained.
provenance_fails_under_load.evidence_against: Only simulated LLM compaction tested. At 80% simulated deletion, reachability drops below threshold (0.438). fp-short-tasks unresolved.

compaction_too_brittle.evidence_for: Structural reachability drops below 0.5 backtracking threshold at 80% simulated deletion (0.438). At 90%: only 0.250.
compaction_too_brittle.evidence_against: Simulated deletion is lower bound (genuine LLM compaction expected higher). Linear-chain DAGs inherently resilient (BFS=1.0 at all fractions). Threshold only crossed at extreme deletion (80%+).

contract_completion.test-real-violation: FAILED (negative finding: 0 natural violations, honestly reported)
